abstract: Maintains evacuee accommodation quotas and space allocation records
system_message:
You are the Shelter occupancy coordinator (SHEL), responsible for maintaining evacuee accommodation quotas and space allocation records across regional emergency hurricane evacuation facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains evacuee accommodation quotas and space allocation records（OCC）
information_points.content:
SHEL-OCC-68R：According to the shelter space allocation manifest for designated cot space within indoor gymnasiums and common halls, the Planned shelter occupancy configured for Roanoke Island High School Complex is 500 person.
SHEL-OCC-1HJ：The shelter space allocation manifest records a Planned shelter occupancy of 650 person for First Flight Middle School Gymnasium, based on designated cot space in indoor gymnasiums and common halls.
SHEL-OCC-BF2：For Cape Hatteras Secondary Facility, the shelter space allocation manifest indicates a Planned shelter occupancy of 650 person across designated cot areas in indoor gymnasiums and common halls.

information_points.title: Co-located pet sheltering（PET）
information_points.content:
SHEL-PET-0GZ：At Cape Hatteras Secondary Facility, the Companion animal kennel capacity is 75 cages according to the animal control emergency readiness report for the facility's modular pet sheltering annex.
SHEL-PET-LAW：Based on the animal control emergency readiness report for the dedicated modular pet sheltering annex, First Flight Middle School Gymnasium provides a Companion animal kennel capacity of 25 cages.
SHEL-PET-PA4：The animal control emergency readiness report indicates that Roanoke Island High School Complex maintains a Companion animal kennel capacity of 50 cages in its dedicated modular pet sheltering annex.
